# Quarterly review: orders from email to invoice

## Email orders come first
Purchase orders that arrive by email come first; phone orders stay on the order sheet for now [E-01].

::: notes
The client owner decided this on 13 October 2026.
:::

## About 40 email orders a day
About 40 purchase orders arrive by email each day [E-04].

::: notes
The operations team gave this count for October.
:::

## Invoices without retyping
The day's orders reach the bookkeeping system as invoices without retyping [E-03].

::: notes
This is the plan's fourth change.
:::

## A weekly email, no standing call
Updates come as a short weekly email, with no standing call [E-02].

::: notes
Agreed at the check-in on 13 October 2026.
:::

## Next quarter
We recommend reviewing the phone orders once the spring rush ends.

::: notes
An opinion, not a sourced fact.
